title: What do you want to do {with}?
lead: {name} runs the briefing in the conversation, no forms.
empty: Nothing with “{query}”. Write what you need in the conversation: {ref} will understand.
foot: When the request involves another specialty, {ref} brings in whoever is needed in the same conversation.

state.works: {count, plural, one {# work item} other {# work items}}

noDelivery: This request has no delivery in this version yet. Write what you need in the conversation.
kaiaWaiting: Kaia’s pieces are waiting for the image engine. Nothing is created before it arrives.

nProj.label: Start a new project
nProj.text: You share the goal; I set up stages, team and deadlines.
nProj.ask: I want to start a new project.

nCamp.label: Coordinate a campaign
nCamp.text: Strategy, pieces, copy and acquisition in a single plan.
nCamp.ask: I want to coordinate a campaign.

nDele.label: Hand a task to the squad
nDele.text: Say what you need; I pick who does it and follow up.
nDele.ask: I want to hand a task to the squad.

nAcomp.label: Follow the deliveries
nAcomp.text: What moved, what slipped and what comes next.
nAcomp.ask: I want to follow the deliveries.

nAppr.label: Review what awaits my approval
nAppr.text: Everything that depends on you, by deadline.
nAppr.ask: I want to review what awaits my approval.

bDiag.label: Analyze my business
bDiag.text: Diagnosis: strengths, opportunities and what to do first.
bDiag.ask: I want to analyze my business.

bMerc.label: Analyze the market and competitors
bMerc.text: Nearby businesses: what they sell, what they charge, how they show up.
bMerc.ask: I want to analyze the market and competitors.

bPos.label: Define the positioning
bPos.text: How {business} wants to be remembered, in one sentence.
bPos.ask: I want to define the positioning of {business}.

bPlan.label: Build a plan
bPlan.text: Goals with numbers, priorities and who owns each one.
bPlan.ask: I want to build a marketing plan.

bOpp.label: Find opportunities
bOpp.text: Where {business} can grow with what it already has.
bOpp.ask: I want to find opportunities for {business} to grow.

kId.label: Create or review the visual identity
kId.text: Colors, type and the way {business} shows up.
kId.ask: I want to create or review the visual identity.

kPost.label: Create a social media piece
kPost.text: Post, stories or cover, looking like {business}.
kPost.ask: I want to create a social media piece.

kCar.label: Create a carousel
kCar.text: A story across several slides, with Otto’s copy.
kCar.ask: I want to create a carousel.

kPromo.label: Create promotional materials
kPromo.text: Posters, labels and menus for the store.
kPromo.ask: I want to create promotional materials.

kImg.label: Edit and adapt images
kImg.text: Formats, crops and tweaks to your photos.
kImg.ask: I want to edit and adapt images.

kVid.label: Produce videos and motion
kVid.text: Short reels and animations with the brand.
kVid.ask: I want to produce a video.

oPlan.label: Plan the content
oPlan.text: Topics, formats and frequency for the coming weeks.
oPlan.ask: I want to plan the content.

oCal.label: Prepare the editorial calendar
oCal.text: Dates, channels and what goes out each day.
oCal.ask: I want to prepare the editorial calendar.

oPost.label: Create a post
oPost.text: Idea and caption; Kaia makes the piece.
oPost.ask: I want to create a post.

oTxt.label: Write copy and articles
oTxt.text: For the website, the blog or emails, in the voice of {business}.
oTxt.ask: I want to write copy and articles.

oSeo.label: Write to show up on Google
oSeo.text: Content based on the searches Kiwi finds.
oSeo.ask: I want to write content to show up on Google.

oProg.label: Schedule the content
oProg.text: I leave it scheduled; nothing goes out without your authorization.
oProg.ask: I want to schedule the content.

gSeo.label: See where {business} can show up on Google
gSeo.text: SEO analysis: searches, competitors and pages.
gSeo.ask: I want to analyze the organic growth opportunities of my brand.

gOrg.label: Bring more visits without ads
gOrg.text: Google Profile, website and content working together.
gOrg.ask: I want to bring more visits without paying for ads.

gPaid.label: Plan a paid campaign
gPaid.text: Goal, audience, budget and what to measure.
gPaid.ask: I want to plan a paid campaign.

gAds.label: Optimize a campaign
gAds.text: Tweaks to what is live, always within the cap.
gAds.ask: I want to optimize a campaign.

gAud.label: Review budget and audiences
gAud.text: Who to advertise to and how much it makes sense to invest.
gAud.ask: I want to review the budget and the audiences.

gCro.label: Turn more visits into orders
gCro.text: Optimize the path from the website to the order.
gCro.ask: I want more visits to turn into orders.

gTest.label: Create a conversion test
gTest.text: One hypothesis, two versions and a clear result.
gTest.ask: I want to create a growth test.

mPub.label: Organize my audiences
mPub.text: Who is a customer, who just follows and who disappeared.
mPub.ask: I want to organize my audiences.

mSeg.label: Segment customers
mSeg.text: Groups by frequency, preference and moment.
mSeg.ask: I want to segment my customers.

mCamp.label: Plan a relationship campaign
mCamp.text: Messages for people who already know {business}.
mCamp.ask: I want to plan a relationship campaign.

mJour.label: Create a journey
mJour.text: Messages in sequence, at the right moment.
mJour.ask: I want to create a customer journey.

mFlow.label: Prepare message flows
mFlow.text: Email and WhatsApp, with clear sending rules.
mFlow.ask: I want to prepare message flows.

mReat.label: Reactivate inactive customers
mReat.text: People who have not bought in 60 days, only with consent.
mReat.ask: I want to reactivate inactive customers.

mLead.label: Capture and reactivate customers
mLead.text: Bring new contacts and win back those who left.
mLead.ask: I want to capture and reactivate customers.

iInd.label: Analyze a metric
iInd.text: What changed, when and what coincides with it.
iInd.ask: I want to analyze a metric.

iCmp.label: Compare periods
iCmp.text: Week, month or quarter against the previous one.

iInt.label: Interpret a result
iInt.text: In plain words, without making up a cause.
iInt.ask: I want to understand a result.

iRep.label: Build a report
iRep.text: For you or to show someone.
iRep.ask: I want to build a report.

iInv.label: Investigate a problem
iInv.text: When something drops or a number makes no sense.
iInv.ask: I want to investigate a problem.

iOpp.label: Follow an opportunity
iOpp.text: Measure whether an idea is working.
iOpp.ask: I want to follow an opportunity.
